d:
There is this simple kind of wealth that can never be measured and replaced. It appears in slow mornings, deep conversations, the warmth of the sun on your skin and the feeling of being completely present for a single breath.
The world teaches us to collect more, achieve more, become more. Yet most of the most meaningful moments arrive when we stop reaching and simply allow ourselves to experience what is right here and now.
I realize more and more that peace isn’t found at the end of the journey. It walks beside us, waiting for the moment we finally notice.
